records.objectives_text: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.

records.name: Scavenging Deathknell
records.objectives_text: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.

records.name: Milly Osworth
records.objectives_text: Speak with Milly Osworth.

records.name: Milly's Harvest
records.objectives_text: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

records.name: Grape Manifest
records.objectives_text: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

records.name: Disharmony of Flame
records.objectives_text: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

records.name: Disharmony of Fire
records.objectives_text: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.

records.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
records.objectives_text: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring

records.name: The Videre Elixir
records.objectives_text: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

records.name: Meet at the Grave
records.objectives_text: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.

records.name: A Grave Situation
records.objectives_text: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

records.name: Linken's Sword
records.objectives_text: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.

records.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
records.objectives_text: Bring the Broken Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket.

records.name: Nugget Slugs
records.objectives_text: Bring 15 Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in the Barrens.

records.name: Rilli Greasygob
records.objectives_text: Bring the :Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Samophlange Manual
records.objectives_text: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

records.name: A Gnome's Assistance
records.objectives_text: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.

records.name: Linken's Memory
records.objectives_text: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

records.name: Linken's Adventure
records.objectives_text: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

records.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
records.objectives_text: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge. Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.

records.name: Commander Gor'shak
records.objectives_text: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

records.name: What Is Going On?
records.objectives_text: Defend Gor'shak.
